description.narrative:
The Eco-Twist Green Generation Initiative is a youth-led project responding to the growing plastic waste that blocks drainage systems, pollutes waterways, and increases flooding and climate-related risks in Bo, Sierra Leone. Born out of young people’s collective desire for a cleaner and more sustainable city, the initiative transforms plastic waste into economic and environmental opportunity.This 12-month initiative aims to empower young people to collect and transform at least 5 tons of plastic waste into durable, market-ready products such as hammocks, floor mats, fans, plastic-woven country cloths, and traditional wedding attire Beyond livelihoods, the initiative emphasizes awareness raising reaching over 10,000 people through school and community outreach. The project will foster collective action in waste management and strengthen youth participation in climate governance, through policy dialogue series,stakeholder coordination and development of policy briefs.
Goal: Reduce plastic waste in Bo City while promoting inclusive, youth-led green livelihoods that strengthen climate resilience and improve socio-economic outcomes for young people and women. Objectives:Reduce plastic waste; create green jobs for youth and women; boost community awareness and participation in climate governance. Activities: Hold inception meeting, train 10 youth and women, recycle 5,000kg of plastic into market-ready cultural products, establishyouth-led production and sales units, conduct school and community outreach/ clean-ups, host district dialogue series, develop and present two policy brief and conduct regular accountability, monitoring, <(>&<)> evaluation sessions

participating-org.narrative:
Aspire! Youth Empowerment and Innovation Hub (A!YEIH) is a youth-led, not-for-profit community-based organization established in 2023 in Sierra Leone, emerging from the Africa Matters Ambassadors Program (2023–2024 cohort). The organization is founded onthe conviction that inherent in young people are hidden potentials that can be outsourced to drive sustainable social, economic, and political transformation. A!YEIH envisions a world where every young person is empowered to contribute meaningfully to social and political change within their communities and beyond. Its mission is to promote a society in which young people serve as catalysts of positivechange through innovative leadership, digital skills, entrepreneurship, climate resilience and advocacy.
Guided by its 2024–2026 Strategy Paper, the organization pursues 4 strategic objectives :
1). enhancing digital and innovative skills to promote decent jobsand youth-led entrepreneurship. 2).fostering leadership and career development to help young people discover their purpose, maximize their potential, and apply practical, solution-oriented skills.
3). building climate resilience by empowering youth to advance environmental sustainability and locally driven climate solutions.
4) and promoting advocacy and civic engagement to amplify youth voices in, peace building, good governance, gender equality, and other pressing social issues.
To deliver on this mission, A!YEIH implements integrated programs under four thematic pillars: the Digital and Innovation Program, Leadership Development Program, ClimateResilience Program, and Advocacy Engagement Program. Across all its work, the organization is guided by core values, including youth power and leadership, creativity and innovation, diversity and inclusion, education and lifelong learning, accountability and transparency, and collaboration and partnership.
